description: Custom lightweight feature registry for Retailrocket recommendation training and inference.

feature_views.name: retailrocket_user_features
feature_views.transformation: Aggregates Retailrocket user interaction history from mart.retailrocket_user_features and derives activity, conversion, and intensity features.
feature_views.description: User-level behavioral features for Retailrocket visitors.

feature_views.name: retailrocket_item_features
feature_views.transformation: Aggregates Retailrocket item interactions and joins latest category and availability metadata from mart.retailrocket_item_features.
feature_views.description: Item-level popularity, conversion, and metadata features for candidate ranking.

feature_views.name: retailrocket_user_item_features
feature_views.transformation: Aggregates Retailrocket user-item interaction history and enriches it with item metadata and implicit labels.
feature_views.description: User-item interaction features for supervised and implicit-feedback recommendation modeling.
